rules.statement: Scope is workplace and technical writing only; personal prose is out of scope even when asked in the profiled author's voice.
When the user did not name a format, infer it and state the format picked in the report -- a silent pick invalidates the score.
Load the profile before drafting: read all seven files (shape card, exemplar, layer1, layer2, layer4, layer3-substance, negative list) for the chosen format.
After drafting, diff the draft against the exemplar line by line and rewrite any sentence whose structure mirrors an exemplar sentence, even if every word is different.
Track each Layer 3 stance used in the draft and report it with its grounded / extrapolated tag.
Treat Layer 4 absences and the entire negative list as hard constraints: when a sentence seems to need a listed tell, rewrite the sentence.
Take every product, service, and system name from the user's request -- do not invent names.
Run the validator and never substitute your own judgment for its result -- the validator is the only pass/fail authority.
On validator failure, surface it and stop: report the full validator output and leave iterating to the user after they see the report.
A clean validator run is necessary, not sufficient: before handing over, read the draft for reflexive rule-of-three lists, inline-header bullet lists, and negative-list category-5 sourcing problems.
The exemplars are synthetic: never copy their phrasing or slot-fill their sentence structures, even though no real author's text is involved.
A low Delta is not evidence the voice landed: report the number but never present it as vouching for the draft.
If the validator exits 2 (incomplete install, usually a missing layer1 file), tell the user rather than guessing at targets.
This skill never edits voice-profile/; profile updates go through the updating-voice-profile skill.

excluded.reason: Voice-shape output targets (mean sentence length and sentence-length variance) -- wrong-track: shape-testing.
Use Layer 2's named patterns for openings, transitions, and argument structure -- wrong-track: shape-testing.
Draw Layer 3 stances only where the topic calls for them -- output-content shaping -- wrong-track: shape-testing.
Write the draft to a temp path or the user-named path -- how-to guidance with no competing incentive.

The Report step's always-show list (format, pass/fail, Structural signals table, Delta, out-of-range metrics, hits with line numbers, stances split) -- form of the report artifact -- wrong-track: shape-testing.
Title-case headings and empty sections do not gate because they did not separate real docs from AI slop -- documented validator fact -- wrong-track: retrieval-testing.
